results.content: > “a machine-based system that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments.” – see OECD Explanatory Memorandum for further clarification [(2024[6];](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#OEC2412_5a7a4205e9) [[7])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_623da898_5a7a4205e9). This includes developing foundational pieces on the technical underpinnings of AI and its use and implications by and for government [(2019[8];](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_726fd39d_5a7a4205e9) [[9])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_932780bc_5a7a4205e9); targeted analysis on specific countries [(2022[10];](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_1f334543_5a7a4205e9) [2024[11];](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_609808d6_5a7a4205e9) [[12])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_421c1244_5a7a4205e9); surfacing government innovation trends, which often involve AI;3 and establishing a preliminary framework for AI in government [(2024[13])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_26324bc2_5a7a4205e9). If governments and other AI actors are successful in seizing AI’s benefits while mitigating its risks, AI experts and researchers envision a future in which AI contributes to scientific and medical breakthroughs, such as discovering new cancer treatments; catalyses productivity growth from a 1-7% rise in global gross domestic product (GDP) by 2033 to a 10-fold increase in the decades to come; eliminates poverty and reduces inequality; and helps address weather-related impacts and natural disasters [(OECD, 2024[14])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_3f4e3dfb_5a7a4205e9).

results.title: Catalog
results.content: Interlink publishes works of literature-in-translation, history, activism, politics, art, cultural guides, award-winning cookbooks, and illustrated children’s books from around the world. A Traveller’s History of Athens describes the whole history of this great city from mythological and prehistoric times, through its artistic flowering in the classical age; its transformation in Roman times from a major player in world politics to a quiet university city; its decline into ruin and insignificance in the Middle Ages when it became the playground of Crusaders and their successors; the long period of subjection to the Ottoman empire; its recreation as the capital of a new nation in the nineteenth century, and one of the finest new-classical cities in Europe; its troubled history in the twentieth century and its continuing place in the hearts and minds of all visitors.
